question.title: Be Specific with Your Questions!
question.description: Specific questions lead to much better interpretations than vague ones.
question.goodExampleText: "What should I do to develop a good relationship with him/her?"
question.tipText: Including specific times or situations yields more accurate advice.

interpretation.title: Go with Your Feeling!
interpretation.description: Don't overthink it. The first feeling you get from a card is the most important.
interpretation.uprightText: The card's energy is active and positive.
interpretation.reversedText: The energy is weak or directed inward.
interpretation.tipText: Connect the cards to form a single, unfolding story.

timing.title: Read with Intention!
timing.description: It's not good to ask the same question over and over again.
timing.goodText: Before a big decision, or when your mind is calm.
timing.badText: When you're highly emotional or after drinking.
timing.tipText: It's best to wait at least 1-2 weeks before asking the same question.
